en: Commemorative illustrated postcard honoring a Catholic bishop. In the center is an oval portrait of an elderly clergyman in black cassock with red piping and a pectoral cross, framed by a green oval with a bishop's coat of arms and mitre above. Dates 1875 and 1925 appear below the portrait, and 1899 and 1924 above, indicating jubilees. On the left is a church with a tall spire set against mountains; on the right stands an angel holding an image of cherubs. Decorative panels with angels run along the top, and a chalice-like element and draped garlands frame the lower part. Below the illustration is German text dedicated to Dr. Paul Wilhelm von Keppler, Bishop of Rottenburg.
